verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a built-in AI layer, Ramp Intelligence and Ramp agents. These agents autonomously code expenses, apply invoice logic, approve or escalate within policy, scan for anomalies, draft memos, and parse contracts to auto-fill procurement requests, so users can hand off defined finance workflows to in-product AI. The natural-language task delegation in the evidence goes through external assistants (ChatGPT, Claude) via MCP or the CLI, which does not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: an in-product conversational assistant users can direct with arbitrary tasks, evidence of user-initiated rather than workflow-preset delegation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
